rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_food','total','int(10) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_food','r1','int(10) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_food','r2','int(10) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_food','r3','int(10) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_food','r4','int(10) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_food','r5','int(10) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_food','r6','int(10) DEFAULT 0 ');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_kpi_food(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) DEFAULT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) DEFAULT NULL,
  target int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	target2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	target3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	result3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	target4 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	result4 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	total int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	r1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	r2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	r3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	r4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	r5 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	r6 int(10) DEFAULT 0,

	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_kpi_food WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_kpi_food 
(
  id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,total,target,result,r1,r2,r3,r4,r5,r6
)
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode, p.check_vhid as areacode
			,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,COUNT(DISTINCT p.cid) total
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.check_t =1,f.cid,NULL )) target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.check_t =1 AND f.check_r=1  ,f.cid,NULL )) result

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.check_t =1 AND f.m1_code =1 ,f.cid,NULL )) result1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.check_t =1 AND f.m2_code =1 ,f.cid,NULL )) result2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.check_t =1 AND f.m3_code =1 ,f.cid,NULL )) result3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.check_t =1 AND f.m4_code =1 ,f.cid,NULL )) result4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.check_t =1 AND f.m5_code =1 ,f.cid,NULL )) result5
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.check_t =1 AND f.m6_code =1 ,f.cid,NULL )) result6
FROM
t_food_milk f INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON f.cid=p.CID
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
WHERE p.check_typearea IN(1,3) AND p.NATION IN(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9) 
AND f.date_ok BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
GROUP BY h.hoscode,p.check_vhid
);
rows.aname: เด็กอายุครบ 6 เดือน ที่แม่หรือผู้เลี้ยงดู ตอบว่ากินนมแม่อย่างเดียว
rows.bname: เด็กอายุครบ 6 เดือนในปีงบประมาณ ที่แม่หรือผู้เลี้ยงดูได้ถูกสอบถามเรื่องการกินนมแม่
rows.notice:
- ประมวผลจากเด็กในเขตรับผิดชอบที่มีอายุครบ 6 เดือนในปีงบประมาณ จากแฟ้ม person
- ประวัิตการกินนมแม่ได้จากแฟ้ม nutrition โดยเก็บประวัติย้อนหลังตั้งแต่แรกเกิดจนถึงอายุ 6 เดือน
- หากพบประวัติทุกครั้งที่ตอบคำถาม ว่ากินนมแม่อย่างเดียว จะถือว่าเด็กกินนมแม่อย่างเดียว
- เช่นกันหากมีการตอบคำถามครั้งใดครั้งหนึ่งว่าไม่ได้กินนมแม่อย่างเดียวจะถือว่าไม่ผ่านเกณฑ์
rows.indiv_sql:
SET @prov_c := ( SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1 );
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx (PRIMARY KEY (CID)) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 IGNORE  AS
SELECT h.hoscode hospcode,p.PID,p.CID,p.NAME,p.LNAME,p.BIRTH,p.SEX,p.NATION,p.check_typearea
,p.addr,p.check_vhid,p.DISCHARGE,p.HID
,f.date_ok
,m1_date,m1_code,m1_place,m1_hosp
,m2_date,m2_code,m2_place,m2_hosp
,m3_date,m3_code,m3_place,m3_hosp
,m4_date,m4_code,m4_place,m4_hosp
,m5_date,m5_code,m5_place,m5_hosp
,m6_date,m6_code,m6_place,m6_hosp
,IF(check_t=1,'พบประวัติถูกสอบถาม','ไม่พบประวัติการสอบถาม') check_t
,IF(check_r=1,'กินนมแม่อย่างเดียว',null) check_r
FROM t_food_milk f INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON f.cid=p.CID
	INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
WHERE p.check_typearea IN(1,3) AND p.NATION IN(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9) 
AND f.date_ok BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d;

SELECT
h.hoscode,h.hosname,d.PID,d.CID,d.NAME,d.LNAME,d.BIRTH,d.SEX,d.NATION,d.check_typearea,d.addr,d.check_vhid,d.DISCHARGE,d.HID
,d.date_ok
,d.m1_date,d.m1_code,d.m1_place,d.m1_hosp
,d.m2_date,d.m2_code,d.m2_place,d.m2_hosp
,d.m3_date,d.m3_code,d.m3_place,d.m3_hosp
,d.m4_date,d.m4_code,d.m4_place,d.m4_hosp
,d.m5_date,d.m5_code,d.m5_place,d.m5_hosp
,d.m6_date,d.m6_code,d.m6_place,d.m6_hosp
,d.check_t,d.check_r
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("total") as "total" ,SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("r1") as "r1" ,SUM("r2") as "r2" ,SUM("r3") as "r3" ,SUM("r4") as "r4" ,SUM("r5") as "r5" ,SUM("r6") as "r6"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
